name: h1: phase numbering touches rows of other companies
find:
FROM job_phases WHERE job_id = p_job_id AND company_id = v_company AND msp_uid IS NULL)
    UPDATE job_phases p
replace:
FROM job_phases WHERE job_id = p_job_id AND msp_uid IS NULL)
    UPDATE job_phases p
reason: since r4 M2 the numbering UPDATE itself re-checks company_id (and job_id), so a row of another company is never numbered even when the CTE selects it; the CTE predicate only keeps the row numbers dense

name: h1: task numbering touches rows of other companies
find:
FROM job_tasks WHERE job_id = p_job_id AND company_id = v_company AND msp_uid IS NULL)
    UPDATE job_tasks t
replace:
FROM job_tasks WHERE job_id = p_job_id AND msp_uid IS NULL)
    UPDATE job_tasks t
reason: since r4 M2 the numbering UPDATE itself re-checks company_id (and job_id), so a row of another company is never numbered even when the CTE selects it; the CTE predicate only keeps the row numbers dense

name: h1: audit counts phases of other companies
find: SELECT count(*) INTO v_phases FROM job_phases WHERE job_id = p_job_id AND company_id = v_company;
replace: SELECT count(*) INTO v_phases FROM job_phases WHERE job_id = p_job_id;

name: h1: audit counts tasks of other companies
find: SELECT count(*) INTO v_tasks  FROM job_tasks  WHERE job_id = p_job_id AND company_id = v_company;
replace: SELECT count(*) INTO v_tasks  FROM job_tasks  WHERE job_id = p_job_id;

name: counter: export does not use the counter
find: IF v_pnull + v_tnull > 0 THEN v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull); END IF;
replace: IF false THEN v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull); END IF;

name: counter: phases take the tasks' slice of the numbers
find: UPDATE job_phases p SET msp_uid = v_free[n.rn] FROM n
replace: UPDATE job_phases p SET msp_uid = v_free[v_pnull + n.rn] FROM n

name: counter: tasks reuse the phases' numbers
find: UPDATE job_tasks t SET msp_uid = v_free[v_pnull + n.rn] FROM n
replace: UPDATE job_tasks t SET msp_uid = v_free[n.rn] FROM n

name: counter: numbers are asked for one row fewer
find: v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull);
replace: v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull - 1);

name: counter: numbers are asked for another company
find: v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull);
replace: v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, v_pnull + v_tnull);

name: counter: export treats itself as a replace
find: v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull);
replace: v_free := sched_next_uids(p_job_id, v_company, v_pnull + v_tnull, true);

name: r4 M2: task numbering UPDATE: job predicate dropped
find: AND t.id = n.id AND t.job_id = p_job_id AND t.company_id = v_company AND t.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND t.id = n.id AND t.company_id = v_company AND t.msp_uid IS NULL;

name: r4 M2: task numbering UPDATE: company predicate dropped
find: AND t.id = n.id AND t.job_id = p_job_id AND t.company_id = v_company AND t.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND t.id = n.id AND t.job_id = p_job_id AND t.msp_uid IS NULL;

name: r4 M2: task numbering UPDATE: 'no uid yet' predicate dropped
find: AND t.id = n.id AND t.job_id = p_job_id AND t.company_id = v_company AND t.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND t.id = n.id AND t.job_id = p_job_id AND t.company_id = v_company;

name: r4 M2: task numbering UPDATE: back to id only
find: AND t.id = n.id AND t.job_id = p_job_id AND t.company_id = v_company AND t.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND t.id = n.id;

name: r4 M2: phase numbering UPDATE: job predicate dropped
find: AND p.id = n.id AND p.job_id = p_job_id AND p.company_id = v_company AND p.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND p.id = n.id AND p.company_id = v_company AND p.msp_uid IS NULL;

name: r4 M2: phase numbering UPDATE: company predicate dropped
find: AND p.id = n.id AND p.job_id = p_job_id AND p.company_id = v_company AND p.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND p.id = n.id AND p.job_id = p_job_id AND p.msp_uid IS NULL;

name: r4 M2: phase numbering UPDATE: 'no uid yet' predicate dropped
find: AND p.id = n.id AND p.job_id = p_job_id AND p.company_id = v_company AND p.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND p.id = n.id AND p.job_id = p_job_id AND p.company_id = v_company;

name: r4 M2: phase numbering UPDATE: back to id only
find: AND p.id = n.id AND p.job_id = p_job_id AND p.company_id = v_company AND p.msp_uid IS NULL;
replace: AND p.id = n.id;

name: r5 M-A: phase numbering not capped at the counted phases
find: WHERE n.rn <= v_pnull AND p.id = n.id
replace: WHERE p.id = n.id

name: r5 M-A: task numbering not capped at the counted tasks
find: WHERE n.rn <= v_tnull AND t.id = n.id
replace: WHERE t.id = n.id

name: r5 M-A: phase cap off by one
find: WHERE n.rn <= v_pnull AND p.id = n.id
replace: WHERE n.rn <= v_pnull + 1 AND p.id = n.id

name: r5 M-A: task cap off by one
find: WHERE n.rn <= v_tnull AND t.id = n.id
replace: WHERE n.rn <= v_tnull + 1 AND t.id = n.id

name: r5 M-A: phase cap uses the task count
find: WHERE n.rn <= v_pnull AND p.id = n.id
replace: WHERE n.rn <= v_tnull AND p.id = n.id
